lines.line: This game was made in a single session by Opus 5.5.
It started from a forty five second reference reel, and one instruction: transfer the style, not the content.
The first attempt missed badly, with flat images where there should have been geometry.
So it rebuilt everything in real 3D, rigged the character from scratch, and began measuring its own work.
Sixteen versions later, the game is playable.
